Agent Name: LocalHistorian_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to verify the actual existence of the listed gyms in West Virginia. The previous steps relied on a "mock dataset" containing fictional names like "River Fitness Center" and "CrossFit Point Pleasant," which do not exist in reality. By accepting and presenting these fabricated results as the verified answer without cross-referencing real-world data or acknowledging the lack of real data, the LocalHistorian_Expert propagated the error, resulting in a list of non-existent gyms instead of the real ones (The Root Sports & Fitness Center and Muscle Headz Gym).
